text: In the US, Google allows debt settlement and debt management ads only from approved non-profit credit counseling agencies, and only after certification. The policy doesn't mention bankruptcy lawyers.
whatToDo: Keep bankruptcy ads about Chapter 7 and 13 representation. Avoid 'settle your debt' or 'lower your payments' offers, which read like debt settlement or management.
